You are going abroad. A pleasant trip in good company is coming soon. You may have to leave familiar places for a while and live in a different climate.

You walk through a green valley. Your affairs will clearly improve, and love will bring harmony. A bare, barren valley means the opposite: stagnation and setbacks. A marshy one points to worries and tiredness.
You see a vineyard. Your investments will pay off, and love will turn out happily. A neglected, foul-smelling vineyard means your brightest hopes may disappoint.
You see a volcano. Heated arguments lie ahead that could hurt your reputation as an honest person. For a young woman, the dream advises reining in greed and keeping out of dubious adventures.
You see a waterfall. Your boldest wish will come true, and luck will help you at every step. The mightier and brighter the waterfall, the more generous your luck will be.

You draw water from a well. Your heartfelt wishes will come true. Muddy water in the well means unpleasantness. Falling into a well points to despair; do not give in to it. An empty well warns against trusting strangers or you may lose money. A well with a pump brings new chances. A spring gushing from the ground leads to knowledge and pleasure.
You see a whirlpool. Serious danger is brewing in your affairs; be extremely careful. Keep away from dubious intrigues: they could stain your good name.

You see acorns. Pleasant things and good gains lie ahead. Picking acorns from the ground — success after long work. Shaking them from the oak — your wishes in work or love will come true fast. Rotten acorns — disappointment. Pulling green ones off — haste will hurt you.

You look down into an abyss. Arguments and reproaches lie ahead and will drain your strength; take care of your property. Falling into the abyss — a deep disappointment. Crossing it or going around it — you will win back your position.
You see an anchor. Changes lie ahead: a move or a trip to distant places. For sailors, an anchor in calm seas — good luck. For lovers — a small quarrel.
You feel an earthquake. Upheavals at work and troubled times around you lie ahead. Hold on to what is solid and avoid risky moves until things settle down.
You see an eclipse of the sun. Temporary setbacks at work and discord in the family. An eclipse of the moon tells you to look after your health and not to skip rest.

You are on an island in a clear river. Pleasant trips and successful ventures are waiting for you. For a woman, this dream promises a happy marriage. A bare, empty island: do not lose happiness and money through excess. Seeing an island from afar: after long efforts, calm and comfort will come.

You see a grove of oaks. Great prosperity in every part of life awaits you. An oak full of acorns promises growth and promotion. An oak split by lightning warns of sudden shocks. For sweethearts, the dream promises a happy start to life together soon.
You see autumn. You will gain prosperity thanks to other people's efforts. Thinking of an autumn wedding in the dream — a happy marriage and a cosy home.
You see trees and bushes in bloom. A time of happy prosperity is drawing near. The richer the blossom, the brighter the time that lies ahead of you.

You see dark, heavy clouds. Dark clouds warn of setbacks caused by poor decisions. Rain falling from them — worries and tiredness. Bright clouds with the sun shining through — success after hard times. Clouds with stars — brief joys and small wins.

You walk through a field of blooming clover. Prosperity will soon come to you, and what you want will be within reach. Withered clover — regrets. For a young woman seeing a snake in the clover — she may be let down in love, though from the outside all will look happy.
You see coloured coral. A lasting friendship awaits you: a loyal friend will never tire of helping you through trouble. White coral — a warning of unfaithfulness in love.

Darkness overtakes you on a journey. Your new work will go slowly; keep your temper in check. If the sun breaks through before the journey ends, you will put your mistakes right. Losing a friend or child in the dark means many things will try your patience; stay calm.
You watch the day break. Your undertakings will succeed. If the dawn looks hazy and strange, success in work or love may slip away at the last moment.

You dive into clear water. An awkward situation will end well. Diving into muddy water means worry about how things are going. Seeing others dive means pleasant company. For lovers, the dream promises a dream come true and passionate love.

You are drowning. Take care of your property and health: hard times lie ahead. If you are rescued, you will rise to wealth and honour. If you save someone who is drowning, you will help a friend rise and find well-earned happiness yourself.

You see fire. Fire is a good sign if you don't get burned: it promises lasting well-being. Lighting a fire: pleasant surprises and visits from afar. Fighting flames: you will have to work hard for your wealth. Seeing your home on fire: love and harmony in the family. Getting burned: be careful.
You watch fireworks. Joy, fun and good health lie ahead. For a young woman, this dream promises parties and pleasant trips to faraway places.

You see a garden in bloom. Bright, fresh flowers mean joy and gain. White flowers bring a touch of sadness; withered ones, disappointment. For a young woman, receiving a bouquet means many admirers. Flowers on bare ground: you'll face a trial, but your cheerful energy will lead you to success.

You are walking through thick fog. Worries and troubles at work lie ahead. Coming out of the fog: a tiring but rewarding journey. For a young woman, getting out of the fog means her good name will be restored.

You see frost on a dark, gloomy morning. You may end up in a strange land, but your wanderings will end in peace. Frost on a sunlit landscape: you'll turn away from empty pleasures and earn respect. For a young woman, the dream advises caring for her partner's feelings while he is away.

You walk through lush green grass. A very good dream: a happy life, fast-growing wealth, recognition and calm love. Withered patches in the green grass: some tiredness or hitches at work. Dry, dead grass: the opposite, luck turns away for now.

You are caught in a hailstorm. Things you've started may not go as well as you'd like. Hail falling through sunshine and rain: your worries won't last, and luck will soon smile on you. For a young woman, the dream promises love after slights. Hearing hail drumming on the roof: unsettling events.
You are worn out by the heat. Your plans may fall through because someone lets you down. Do not share your ideas with everyone. Keep important plans to yourself until the job is done.
You see herbs. There will be some bother, but joy will follow it. Poisonous herbs: beware of ill-wishers. Lemon balm and other healing herbs: success at work and warm friendships.

You see ice. Worry is ahead: ill-wishers will try to spoil your best work. Walking on ice: do not risk what is solid for a passing thrill. Icicles on the roof: a lack of comfort, so look after your health. Icicles falling from trees: trouble will soon melt away. Eating ice: look after your health.

You see ivy on the wall of a house. Good health, a rising income and plenty of joy are waiting for you. For a young woman, ivy promises honour and recognition. Ivy on a wall in moonlight: secret dates. Withered ivy: a broken engagement and sadness.

You see green leaves. Happiness and clear progress in your affairs await you. Withered leaves mean false hopes and gloom. For a young woman, fresh green leaves promise an inheritance and a good marriage, while dry ones mean a lonely stretch for a while.
You see a bright light. Success will be with you. A dim light means partial success. A strange light, or a light that goes out, means a venture that ends in nothing.

You see flashes of lightning. Happiness and luck are coming, but they won't last long. Lightning above your head means joy and gain. Lightning striking nearby means gossip or trouble from a friend's luck. Lightning striking you means sudden sorrows in work or love. Lightning from black clouds means threats and losses, so keep a close eye on your affairs and loved ones.

You walk through mud. A friend may let you down, and there may be trouble at home. Seeing others in mud brings ugly rumors about someone you know. Mud on your clothes means someone is attacking your good name. Scraping it off means you will clear yourself of slander.

You are sinking in quicksand. Beware of losses and deceit. You cannot get out — a hard stretch ahead; do not act alone. Your beloved pulls you out — a reliable, faithful partner who will stay in love with you.

You are caught in a clear, light rain. You will enjoy life with youthful zest, and prosperity will come. Rain from dark clouds — worry about how serious your affairs are. Watching a downpour from inside the house — good fortune and love returned. Hearing rain patter on the roof — happiness at home. A stormy downpour — trouble.
You see rocks. Setbacks and discord lie ahead; be patient. Climbing a steep rock: a hard struggle right now; gather your strength and you will manage.
You see tree roots. Your affairs may slow down; save your strength and look after your health. Using roots as medicine: take care of yourself; a tiring stretch is ahead.
You are sailing on calm water. Joys will come easily, and poverty and trouble will pass you by. Sailing a small boat: your wishes will not outgrow your means; everything you plan is within reach.
You see sand. Losses and lean times are possible; be thrifty. Do not build plans on shaky ground; check what you are relying on.
You see seeds. Your prosperity will grow, even if things look bad right now. Sowing seeds: your efforts will sprout well; be patient.
You are gathering seashells. Beware of overspending: empty pleasures will leave only regrets. Spend time and money on what truly makes you happy, not on passing whims.

You are ice skating. Guard your job and your valuables: there is a risk of losing something. Falling through the ice: do not listen to bad advisers. Watching others skate: people may spread gossip about you. Young people on roller skates: good health and joy you bring to others.

You see snow. There will be no real misfortune, but things may move slowly and your mood may dip. Caught in a snowstorm: a long-awaited joy may be delayed. Dirty snow: you will swallow your pride and make peace. Melting snow: your fears will turn to joy.
You see spring arriving. Your new ventures will go well, and cheerful friends will be by your side. Spring arriving at the wrong time means unrest and small losses.

You look at bright stars. Good health and well-being lie ahead. Dim or red stars mean hardship. A shooting star means sadness. Stars that appear and vanish mean strange changes. A star falling on you means worries in the family.

You are in a lush land of fields and clear streams. The very best of times is coming: plenty will pour in. Dry, bare land — you will hear about hard times; save your strength and look after your health.

You see the moon in a clear sky. Luck awaits you in both love and work. A strange, eerie moon warns of trouble in love and at work. A new moon promises a rising income and a happy marriage. Two moons tell you not to chase gain in love. A blood-red moon foretells strife and worry.
You see a clear morning. Luck and joy will come soon. A cloudy morning warns that heavy, important matters will pile up on you.
Night surrounds you. A hard time with an unusual load of worries lies ahead. If the night is fading, what seemed hopeless will improve and your affairs will start to thrive.

You see a calm ocean. Good days await you: work will bring income and love will bring joy. Waves pounding a ship far out at sea warn of trouble at work and stormy days at home. Watching foaming waves from the shore means a narrow escape from harm and from others' schemes. An ocean so shallow you can see the bottom promises joy mixed with worries.

You see the sea. On the surface all will be well, but inside you will long for something greater. Hearing the lonely sound of the sea: a lonely spell; reach out to people close to you. For a young woman, gliding over the sea with her partner: her dearest hopes come true and a happy union.

You see a clear sky. Honors and interesting trips with pleasant company await you. A gloomy sky: your hopes may not come true. Floating in the sky among strange faces and beasts: painful jealousy. The sky turning red: unrest in society.

You see a clear sunrise. Joyful events and well-being await you. The sun at noon means your ambitions will come true. A sunset means success has peaked, so protect what you have. The sun through clouds means troubles are letting go. An eclipse means a stormy time, after which things will be better than before.
You dream about the weather. Your luck will be changeable: quick success may be followed by doubts. Reading a weather forecast points to a move that, after long thought, will do you good.

You walk against a strong wind. You will resist temptation and pursue success with determination. Wind carrying you against your will points to setbacks at work and in love. Wind carrying you where you want to go brings unexpected allies. Hearing the wind moan means longing for someone who misses you.
You see thorns. Dissatisfaction may lie ahead, and moving forward will take effort. Thorns hidden under green leaves mean secret enemies are standing in the way of your success.
You hear thunder. Difficulties may soon begin at work. Be ready. Getting caught in a thunderstorm means trouble is very close. Thunder that shakes the ground means a serious loss.

You pick violets. Happy occasions await you, along with the favour of someone influential. For a young woman, picking violets means she will soon meet her future partner. Dried violets mean feelings may go unanswered.

You see clear water. Well-being and joy await you. Muddy water warns of danger and gloom. Water rising in your house means you will fight trouble and win if it goes down. Falling into muddy water points to bitter mistakes. Drinking clear water means your hopes will come true. Splashing in water means love and passion are awakening.

You see waves. You are planning an important step; if the waves are clear, it will bring you new knowledge and experience. Muddy or stormy waves mean you should not rush: a serious mistake is possible.
You dream of winter. Look after your health: things will move slowly for a while. Do not expect quick results; patience will help you wait out the cold season.
You stand on a balcony. Sad news about people far away is possible. Lovers saying goodbye on a balcony — a long separation.

You receive money at a bank. Good profit and prosperity are waiting for you. Piles of banknotes — rising income and respect. Handing money out yourself — do not be careless. Empty teller windows — losses in your affairs.
You see a barn full of grain. Great prosperity and well-being. Well-fed livestock around the barn — your luck will multiply. An empty barn — shortages; you will have to save.
You carry a full basket. Real success is waiting for you. An empty basket — discontent and sadness.

You take a warm bath. After this dream, be careful in your affairs and in the company you keep. Cold, clear water — happy news and good health. Bathing in a clear sea — growing business and new knowledge. Muddy water — ill-wishers are near. Bathing with others — avoid shady people or your reputation will suffer.
You are in a bathroom. Small troubles will spoil some fun, but a more lasting joy will follow. For a young woman, a bathroom — she is too drawn to empty amusements.

You see a bed. A clean white bed means peace: your worries will soon ease. Making a bed brings a new admirer and pleasant work. Lying in bed in a strange room means unexpected visitors. Sleeping on a bed in the open air promises delightful experiences and a chance to improve your fortunes. Wetting the bed points to troubles that will break your daily routine.

You are sailing in a boat on clear water. Bright prospects and a calm journey ahead. Rough, stormy water means worries and unwelcome changes. Boarding with a cheerful crowd and arriving safely brings luck and many pleasant gifts of fate. Falling overboard in a storm means trouble.
You open a box full of things. Great prosperity and pleasant trips to faraway places. An empty box means disappointment in your work. A full money box means a break from worries and a calm life.

You see a long, rickety bridge vanishing into darkness. Gloom and hard times ahead; for those in love, disappointment in the chosen one. Crossing a bridge safely means you will overcome difficulties, even if your means seem shaky. A bridge collapsing before you warns of betrayal and false admirers. Clear water below means prosperity; muddy water means wasted effort.

You see a new broom. Thrift and a quick improvement in your fortunes. A broom in use means do not gamble with money; risky investments will lead to losses. Losing a broom means disorder and discord at home.

You see a cage full of birds. Great prosperity and joy from children. One bird in a cage means a good marriage. An empty cage means worry about someone close. Wild animals in a cage mean you will overcome enemies and hardships. Being in the cage with them means take care when travelling.

You see a candle burning with a clear, steady flame. The people around you are loyal, and your wellbeing rests on solid ground. For a young woman, lighting a candle means secret meetings with her sweetheart. A candle guttering in a draught means enemies are spreading rumours about you. Putting out a candle means sad news about friends.

You are walking on a carpet. Prosperity and happiness. Seeing a carpet means profit and wealthy friends to help you in need. Buying carpets means great gain. Selling them means a pleasant and profitable trip. For a young woman, a carpet promises a beautiful, cosy home.

You are inside a castle. You will have enough means to live as you wish, and you may travel a lot. An old, ivy-covered castle means you will lean towards romance; do not rush into an engagement. Leaving a castle means losing something valuable, so guard what is yours.

You are in a cold, damp cellar. Doubts and gloomy thoughts will weigh on you; gather your will to drive them off. Look after your property. A cellar stocked with wine and food means you will be offered a share of profits from a doubtful source; think before agreeing.

You see a chair. You may fail to keep a promise, and carelessness could cost you a good position. A friend sits motionless on a chair — news about his health will come. Keep a close eye on your obligations.

You see a chandelier. Unexpected success will let you enjoy comfort and even luxury. A broken or dirty chandelier — a bad deal will hurt your finances. Its light goes out — look after your health and don't celebrate your plans too early.

You see a chimney. Something unpleasant is about to happen, and worrying news about someone's health may arrive. A fire burning in the hearth — great good is coming. A chimney covered in ivy — happiness after sadness. A chimney collapsing — upsets in the family. Climbing up a chimney — you will escape a trap set for you.
You see a decorated Christmas tree. Happy celebrations and good fortune are on their way. The tree is being taken down — something unpleasant may follow the festivities, so stay alert.
You see a college. You will soon get the position you have long been working towards. Being back in college — a piece of work you did well will be noticed and praised.

You see a compass. Good circumstances and honest people ready to help will surround you. You may have to work within tight limits, but that will make your success more honourable. The needle points the wrong way — beware of deception and losses.

You are at a fine concert. Delightful days and success at work lie ahead, and for the young — happy, faithful love. A cheap, shallow show — unpleasant company, ungrateful friends and a slowdown at work.
You lie on a couch. You will cling to false hopes. Watch every change in your affairs — that's the only way your hopes can come true.

You see a cradle with a beautiful baby in it. Prosperity and the love of sweet children await you. Rocking your own baby in a cradle — worry about a family member's health; be more attentive to them. For a young woman rocking a cradle — she should beware of gossip.

You stand at a crossroads. You may fail to hold on to a good opportunity you had before. Not knowing which way to turn — small things will irritate you badly. Choose your road firmly and luck will be on your side. Soon you will face an important decision about work or love.
You see a cupboard full of dishes. A clean cupboard full of shining dishes means comfort and plenty. An empty, dirty cupboard warns of hard times and worries.
You see a dagger. Enemies are preparing trouble for you. If you wrench a dagger from someone's hand, you will defeat your enemies and overcome misfortune.
You are working at a desk. An unexpected setback lies ahead. Money lying on your desk means you will unexpectedly get out of a personal difficulty.

You walk through a door. Gossip follows you and enemies give you no peace. Walking through the door of your childhood home means plenty and harmony. A door that falls off its hinges and hurts someone tells you to be careful with the advice you give friends.
You hear the doorbell ring. Unexpected news, or an urgent call to business. If you ring a doorbell yourself, news that needs a quick decision is coming.
You see a drum. You are peace-loving and avoid quarrels; your affairs will prosper. The muffled beat of a drum means a distant friend is in trouble and needs your help.

You live on a farm. Luck will be with you in everything you take on. Buying a farm means a good harvest, a profitable deal and a safe journey. Visiting a farm brings pleasant company and new friendships.

You climb a fence. Reaching the top means your efforts will be crowned with success. Falling off a fence: you have taken on something beyond your strength. Squeezing through a fence: questionable ways to your goal. Building a fence: thrift and hard work lay the ground for future wealth.
You see a fork. Someone may be after your position; stay alert. For a woman, this dream advises keeping the peace at home; for lovers, avoiding quarrels.

You walk through a gate. Worrying news about someone far away may come soon; work isn't going smoothly yet. A locked gate: present difficulties can't be overcome just yet. Locking a gate yourself: successful ventures and loyal friends. A broken gate: failure and discord. Swinging on a gate: idle pastimes.

Someone gives you a gift. You'll keep up with all your payments and be lucky in money matters or love. Giving a gift yourself: displeasure from others and setbacks; don't expect thanks. For a young woman, rich gifts from her sweetheart promise a happy, comfortable marriage.

You play the guitar. A merry gathering, serious courtship and harmony at home lie ahead. An out-of-tune or broken guitar: disappointment in love. Hearing strange guitar music: beware of flattery and sweet talk.

You hear a gunshot. An unsettling dream: hold on to your job and manage your affairs more carefully. Shooting someone: an act you'll be ashamed of. Being shot: ill-wishers will pester you, so look after your health. For a woman, shooting in a dream means quarrels and gossip.
You see a hammer. To get firmly on your feet, you'll have to overcome a few discouraging obstacles. Don't give up: every blow of the hammer brings you closer to the goal.

You find something hidden. An unexpected joy is waiting for you. Hiding things yourself: an awkward situation. A young woman hiding things: people will gossip about her, but in the end everyone will see she was right.

You visit your old home. Good news is on its way, and it will make you happy. Your old home in ruins: worry about loved ones, so take care of them. Everything cosy and bright at home: harmony in the family and success at work.
You see a hook. You will take on a duty that will weigh on you. Do not rush into promises until you have weighed what they will cost you.

You hear the sound of a horn. Happy news will arrive soon. A broken horn: an unpleasant surprise, so be careful. Children playing with horns: harmony at home. A woman blowing a horn: she wants to marry more than her partner does.

You see a horseshoe. Your affairs will move forward, and love will bring luck. A broken horseshoe: bad luck, so look after your health. A horseshoe hanging on a fence: success beyond your hopes. Picking one up on the road: profit from an unexpected source.

You are a patient in a hospital. There may be fuss and worry around you, but it will pass you by. Take care of yourself. Visiting patients in hospital: worrying news from people far away. Leaving the hospital: you will slip away from cunning rivals.

You are staying in a hotel. Calm and income are waiting for you. A fine hotel: wealth and travel. Owning a hotel: you will earn your fortune yourself. Working in a hotel: you could find a better-paid job than the one you have. A shabby, run-down inn: setbacks and gloomy trips.

You are building a house. You will make wise changes in your affairs. Owning a beautiful house: you will soon move somewhere better, and fate will be kind to you. An old, crumbling house: setbacks at work, so save your strength and look after your health.

You see a hut. Success will be modest, without big leaps. Sleeping in a hut: dissatisfaction and tiredness, so look after your health. A hut in a green meadow: prosperity, though happiness will come and go.

You see people in jail. You will be pushed to grant favours to people you do not trust. Do not give in against your will. A young woman sees her loved one in jail: he may not be who he seems. A jailer: betrayal at work. A mob storming a jail: someone will try to squeeze money out of you.

You see full jars. Success is waiting for you. Empty jars: shortage of money and worries. Buying jars: success will be shaky and the load heavy. Broken jars: deep disappointment, so look after your health.

You set off on a journey. If the trip goes smoothly, expect gain; if trouble gets in the way, expect disappointment. Friends setting off cheerfully: pleasant changes and good new company. Friends leaving sadly: you will not see them for a long time. Arriving much faster than you expected: a job will be done surprisingly quickly and well paid.

You see water boiling in a kettle. Your struggles will soon end, and change will come. Just seeing kettles: a lot of work ahead. A broken kettle: after great effort something may fail, so do not give up. For a young woman, a light-coloured kettle promises a carefree life and a worthy husband.

You find keys. There will be peace at home and a lively turn at work. Just keys: unexpected changes. Losing keys: unpleasant adventures. A broken key: a parting or jealousy. A young woman unlocking a door with a key: a new admirer, but do not trust him too quickly.

You peep through a keyhole. You could hurt someone by giving away a secret. Keep what you are told to yourself. Catching others peeping through a keyhole: false friends are poking into your affairs for their own gain. Not finding the keyhole: you may hurt a friend without meaning to.
You see a kitchen. You will have to deal with sudden hassles that dampen your mood. A woman seeing a clean, tidy kitchen: interesting and lucky turns of fate.

You are flying a kite. Success may look bigger than it really is. Check what your plans rest on. The kite crashes to the ground: disappointment. Children flying kites: pleasant, easy activities. The kite flies out of sight: do not build your hopes too high.

You see a knife. A knife means quarrels, partings and losses at work. Be gentler with those close to you. A sharp, shiny knife: worries, with rivals nearby. A rusty knife: discontent at home. A broken knife: failure in both love and work. Being wounded with a knife: family troubles. Stabbing someone else: work on yourself and your anger.
You hear knocking at the door. Serious news will arrive soon. The knocking wakes you up: the news will affect you more than it seems. Meet it calmly.
You see knots. You will fret a lot over trifles. Do not waste your energy on them. Tying a knot: you have an independent nature and will not let a partner or friend nag you.

You wander through a labyrinth. Your affairs will get tangled, and home may feel tense. A dark labyrinth means a short but hard stretch of worries. A labyrinth of green vines and trees brings unexpected joy where you feared loss. A maze of railway tracks means long, tiring trips with interesting people but little profit.

You climb a ladder. Success and real happiness are coming your way. A ladder set up for you to climb: your energy will bring you to a prominent place. Falling off a ladder means gloom and failed deals. A broken ladder means plans that fall through. Climbing down means disappointment. Escaping captivity by a ladder means success after a risky road. Feeling dizzy on the way up warns you not to let a new position go to your head.

You see a lamp burning brightly. A well-earned rise and happiness at home await you. A lamp full of oil means lively business. An empty lamp means low spirits. A dim light means jealousy and envy around you. Lighting a lamp means a change that pays off. Carrying a lamp means you will rely on yourself. Dropping a lit lamp means plans suddenly collapse. A broken lamp means worry about loved ones.

You see a lantern moving ahead of you in the dark. Unexpected wealth is on its way. If the lantern suddenly disappears, luck will turn against you. Carrying a lantern means your kindness will win many friends. If it goes out, the position you want will stay out of reach for now. Tripping and breaking it means helping others may cost you your own place. Cleaning a lantern means great chances lie ahead. Buying one means lucky deals.
You see something leaking. This points to losses and annoying hassles. Find and fix the small leak in your affairs or money before it grows.

You receive a letter. Letters in dreams usually bring worries, but also important news. A letter with happy news means you will have much to be grateful for. Bad news means difficulties. An anonymous letter means a blow from an unexpected side. Writing a letter warns you not to judge anyone in haste. A torn letter means a mistake could harm your reputation. Dreaming often of a letter from a friend means they will soon visit or get in touch.
You sit in a library. You will want a change and find support in study and new knowledge. Being in a library for something other than books warns you not to fool friends with a show of seriousness.

You see a lock on a door. Confusion lies ahead. If the lock opens easily, you will learn who is working against you, beat a rival and make a profitable trip. If it won't open, expect mockery in love and pointless journeys. Putting a lock on your partner means you doubt their faithfulness, but time will clear your doubts.

You eagerly watch a lottery draw. You may get caught up in a pointless venture that brings needless trouble. Winning means luck that also brings worries. Seeing others win means cheerful get-togethers with friends. Losing warns you of scheming people. For a young woman, the dream advises more care in her affairs and in choosing a partner.
You are inside a grand mansion. Wealth awaits you. Seeing a mansion from afar means future advancement. A haunted room in the mansion means a sudden setback in the middle of good times.

You study a map. You will plan changes in your affairs, and despite small letdowns they will pay off. Looking for a map means discontent with your situation will give you fresh energy and lead you to something better. For a young woman, it promises a rise through her own drive.

You walk through a busy market. Thrift and lively activity in all your affairs lie ahead. An empty market means gloom and slow times. Spoiled vegetables or meat mean losses at work. For a young woman, a market promises pleasant changes.

You put on a mask. Your good intentions will be misread, but the temporary distance will work in your favor. Seeing a mask means someone may be unfaithful to you. Others in masks mean you will have to fight lies and envy. Going to a masquerade warns you not to chase empty fun at the expense of work and home. For a young woman, the dream advises modesty.

You see a mattress. New duties and responsibilities will soon be yours. Sleeping on a new mattress means contentment with what you have. A mattress factory means working with thrifty partners and building wealth fast.
You receive a medal. Hard work and diligence will bring you honor. Losing a medal means a setback caused by someone's disloyalty.
You receive a message. Changes are coming in your affairs. Sending a message yourself means you may land in an awkward spot, so think before you write.

You look at yourself in a mirror. Many letdowns lie ahead, so take care of your health and money. A broken mirror means worry about loved ones. Seeing others in a mirror means someone will treat you unfairly for their own gain. Animals in a mirror mean disappointment and losses. For a young woman, a happy partner in the mirror means a brief tiff, while a pale, weary one means a broken engagement.
You wander through a museum. On the way to your place in life you will see a lot and gain useful knowledge. If the museum is unpleasant to you, there will be many reasons for annoyance.
Someone gives you a necklace. A loving partner and a beautiful home await you. Losing a necklace foretells sadness and worry for your loved ones.

You sew with a needle. Others' indifference may hurt you, so don't expect sympathy where there is none. Threading a needle means you will have to care for people outside your family. Looking for a needle foretells needless worry. Finding one means you will have friends who value you. Breaking one warns of loneliness and short money.
You hear a strange noise. Expect news that is not very pleasant. If the noise wakes you, a sudden turn in your affairs is coming.

You look at paintings. Stay alert: someone around you may deceive you or bear you ill will. Painting a picture — a venture that will not pay. Destroying paintings — you will be forgiven for standing up for yourself harshly. Buying paintings — empty investments. Being surrounded by masterpieces — you will long for ever higher goals, and today’s success will seem small.

You wander through a palace, admiring its splendor. Your prospects are improving, and a new, higher standing awaits you. Seeing elegant people dancing and talking in the palace promises profitable, pleasant acquaintances. For a young woman, being among the guests as an equal foretells a better life through marriage or family help. The dream advises relying on honest work rather than daydreams.

A parcel is delivered to you. The return of someone long absent, or unexpected care, will pleasantly surprise you. Carrying a parcel yourself means you will have an unpleasant task to do. Dropping a parcel on the way warns that some deal will fall through.

You see pearls. Good business and pleasant social occasions lie ahead. Your beloved gives you pearls — celebrations, joy and a faithful partner free of jealousy. Losing or breaking pearls — sadness and misunderstandings. Admiring pearls — you pursue love and wealth with honest intentions.
You see a pen. Your love of adventure may draw you into serious complications. The pen will not write — you may be accused of a dishonest act. Be careful with new ventures.
You see a pencil. Pleasant and rewarding work lies ahead. Writing with a pencil — a happy marriage. Erasing what you wrote — disappointment in your beloved.
You look through a photo album. Success and loyal friends are waiting for you. For a young woman, looking at photos in an album — a pleasant new acquaintance and a fresh romance soon.

You see a piano. A joyful occasion lies ahead. Beautiful music playing — success and good health. Off-key music — annoying problems to deal with. A sad melody — sad news. A broken or out-of-tune piano — dissatisfaction with yourself. Playing a hard but lovely piece — you will win the heart of someone who was indifferent.
You see a soft pillow. Comfort and plenty lie ahead. Making a pillow — a pleasant and hopeful future.

You smoke a pipe. An old friend will visit, and old disagreements will be settled peacefully. Seeing pipes — peace and comfort after long struggle. An old, broken pipe — stagnation in your affairs; take care of your health.

You see a pistol. Generally a sign of bad luck; be careful. Hearing a shot — you will learn of a scheme against your interests. Firing it yourself — do not let envy and resentment push you to take revenge on an innocent person.
You see plates. Thrift and order at home will earn you the love and respect of someone close. Good housekeeping and a sensible home life will strengthen your family or help you find a worthy partner.

You stand on a porch. You will take on something new, and the future is still full of unknowns. Building a porch — new duties. Sitting on a porch with your beloved — doubts about someone’s intentions.

You gaze at a portrait of a beautiful person. There will be joy, but tinged with unease; your affairs may suffer some loss. Do not trust pleasures that come too easily, and keep a closer eye on your affairs.
You see a cooking pot. Small events will irritate you. A boiling pot — pleasant busyness and company. A rusty or broken pot — a bitter disappointment.
You see a baby stroller. A kindred friend will come into your life and plan lovely surprises for you. Stay open to new people: one of them will bring you a lot of joy.

You see the pyramids. Many changes are coming your way. Climbing a pyramid — a long road before your wishes come true. Studying the mysteries of the ancient pyramids — you will come to love the secrets of nature and grow learned and refined.

You see a quilt. Comfort and well-being lie ahead. A clean quilt — your practical good sense will win the respect of someone dear to you. A quilt with holes — your partner will value you, though you dreamed of someone else. A dirty quilt — take care of your appearance and manners; it matters in love.

You see a raft. You will move to a new place, and what you start there will succeed. Floating on a raft — a journey with an unclear outcome; if you reach your goal, good fortune awaits. The raft breaks apart — look after yourself and your friends on the road.

You see a razor. The dream foretells arguments and strife over troubles. Cutting yourself with a razor — bad luck in a deal you are planning. Fighting with a razor — someone will harass you almost beyond endurance. A broken or rusty razor — unavoidable distress.

You are standing on a roof. Great success awaits you. Fearing you will fall: you will rise, but your place will be shaky. A roof caving in: a sudden blow. Fixing or building a roof: your income will grow fast. Sleeping on a roof: you are safe from enemies and full of strength.

You see a rope. Work and love will get tangled, but you have the strength to sort it all out. Climbing a rope: you will beat your enemies. Climbing down: disappointment. Being tied up: you will give in to feelings against your better judgment. Breaking a rope: you will overcome rivals. Walking a tightrope: a risky venture will surprisingly pay off.
You see a ruby. You will be lucky in both work and love. For a woman, losing a ruby means her partner is cooling off; give him more attention.
You see a safe. Your work and love life will be protected from trouble. Trying to open a safe: you will fret that your plans are ripening too slowly. An empty safe: trouble.

You see a ship. Honor and an unexpected rise await you. Hearing of a shipwreck: a sharp turn in your affairs and betrayal by friends. A ship in a storm: a bad deal and fear of exposure. Seeing others shipwrecked: you will try in vain to rescue a friend from trouble.
You see a wreck. Fears of hardship or sudden failure at work may trouble you. Do not panic: build up a safety margin in advance.

You are standing in a shower. A quiet joy awaits: you will discover something new and learn to enjoy pleasures in moderation. The water washes away what you do not need: a good time for a fresh start.
You hold a spoon. You will move ahead, and home life will be warm and calm. Losing a spoon means suspicion. Broken or dirty spoons mean losses and trouble.

You are in a store full of goods. Wealth and progress are coming your way. An empty store means failure and quarrels. Selling in a store means a quick rise thanks to your energy and friends' help. A big department store means income from many sources.

You find yourself in an unfamiliar city. Circumstances will push you to change your home or way of life, and at first this will sadden you. The change can't be avoided — accept it calmly and you will settle into the new place.

You walk down a street. There will be worries and doubts on the way to your goal. Don't give up. A dark street in a faraway city means a trip that won't live up to your hopes. A brightly lit street means quick but empty fun. Fearing an attack in the street means you're on risky ground.

You pack your suitcase. You will soon go on a pleasant trip. Belongings scattered from a trunk mean quarrels and a hasty, joyless trip. An empty trunk means disappointment in love. Being unable to open it means missing a good chance. Being unable to close it means a hoped-for trip will fall through.

You wear a sword. You will hold a visible position with honor. Having your sword taken means losing to a rival. Others carrying swords mean quarrels may turn dangerous. A broken sword means despair, so don't give in to it.

You set the table. Happy gatherings and well-being await you. An empty table means money trouble or disagreements. A broken table means declining fortune. A table moving by itself means you'll long for change. A dirty tablecloth means disobedient children and quarrels after a celebration.
You are in a tent. Changes in your affairs are coming soon. Many tents mean a trip with not-so-pleasant company. A torn tent means trouble.

You are at the theater. New friends will bring you much joy, and your affairs will go well. Acting on stage means short-lived joy. An opera means your wishes will come true. Escaping a theater during a fire or panic means a risky venture.
You see thread. Your luck lies beyond tangled paths. Patience will help you untangle them. Broken threads mean a loss caused by unfaithful friends.
You sit on a throne. You will quickly win recognition and fortune. Stepping down from a throne means disappointment. Seeing others on a throne means you'll prosper thanks to others' support.
You see torches. Pleasant fun and good luck at work await you. Carrying a torch means success in love and tricky matters. A torch going out means failure and distress.
You see a tower. You will aim for great heights. Climbing a tower means your wishes will come true. A tower crumbling as you come down means dashed hopes.

You are caught in a trap. Rivals may outwit you. Be more careful. Setting a trap means you'll use cunning to get your way. Catching game in a trap means success in whatever you do. An empty trap means bad luck. An old or broken trap means a slump at work.
You find a treasure. Unexpected generosity will help you on your way to wealth. Losing a treasure means setbacks at work and fickle friends.

You go through a tunnel. A tricky time is starting in work and love. Be patient. A train coming at you in a tunnel means looking after your health; a job change is possible. A tunnel caving in means failure and spiteful enemies. Looking into a tunnel means you'll soon face a hard decision.

You see a vase. Quiet joys and comfort at home await you. Drinking from a vase points to a secret romance. A broken vase means sadness soon. For a young woman, receiving a vase as a gift means her dearest wish will come true.

You find yourself in a village. Good health and a secure living await you. Returning to the village of your childhood brings pleasant surprises and good news from distant friends. A run-down or blurry village points to sadness and trouble.

You hear a violin. There will be peace and harmony in the family, and no worries about money. For a young woman, playing the violin brings honour and generous gifts; failing to play points to dreams out of reach. A broken violin means sadness and parting.

A wall blocks your way. Outside influences hold you back, and important matters may stall. Jumping over the wall means you will overcome obstacles. Breaking through it means persistence will win. Pulling it down means you will defeat your opponents. Building a wall means careful plans will make your living secure. For a young woman, walking along the top of a wall promises lasting happiness.

You find a wallet full of money. You will be lucky: nearly all your wishes will come true. An empty wallet — disappointment in a big hope. Losing your wallet — a falling-out with your best friend. A purse full of jewels and new bills — you will be surrounded by cheerful, loving, harmonious people.

You see a wristwatch. Well-planned investments will bring you income. Checking the time means rivals may get in your way. Breaking a watch points to worry and loss. Losing one means quarrels at home. Stealing one means a fierce opponent will appear. Giving one as a gift warns against wasting energy on idle fun.
You see a whip. Quarrels and difficult, unlucky friendships lie ahead. Take a closer look at those around you and do not let anyone order you about.

You see windows. Not all your bright hopes will come true; be ready for disappointment. Closed windows point to loneliness. Broken ones mean suspicions of disloyalty. Climbing into a house through a window means your unfair methods will come to light. Sitting on a window sill warns of a foolish act.
You walk around a zoo. Your fortunes will vary: hardship at times, great success at others. The dream promises knowledge and impressions from trips to faraway countries.

You hear accordion music. Cheerful fun will lift you out of sadness, and your load will feel lighter. For a young woman, playing the accordion — love will come through a sad event but bring lasting happiness. An out-of-tune accordion — worry about a loved one.
You walk down a narrow alley. Your luck will be smaller than before, and annoying worries will turn up. Wandering a dark alley at night — beware of shady acquaintances; they may hurt your reputation.
You see an amethyst. You will be content with your affairs and a steady income. For a young woman, losing an amethyst — a falling-out with her beloved; do not let hurt feelings pile up.
You see an arrow. Joy is coming: celebrations, happy gatherings and pleasant trips; your worries will ease. An old or broken arrow — disappointment in love or work.
You go up into the attic. You are building hopes that are unlikely to come true; look at them with clear eyes. Sleeping in an attic — your current work does not satisfy you.

You are at an auction. A good dream overall: bright prospects and fair dealings. Buying at an auction — profitable deals and plenty at home. If you feel regret in the dream — be more careful with your affairs.

You see an axe. Your joys will depend on your own drive and energy. Others using an axe — lively, active friends will be around you. For a young woman — her chosen one will be worthy, though not rich. A rusty or broken axe — take care of your health and money.

You see an explosion. The actions of people close to you will briefly upset you and cause losses. If your face is blackened by the blast, you will be unfairly accused of carelessness. If you are thrown into the air, unworthy friends will abuse your trust.

You see a red-hot oven. Your family and friends will love you for your kindness and generosity. Baking in the oven means small, short-lived disappointments. A broken oven warns of fuss with children and housework.

You walk under an umbrella. Small troubles and annoyances are coming your way. Others with umbrellas mean someone will ask you for help. Borrowing one points to a misunderstanding with a friend. Losing one means friction with someone you trust. A broken umbrella warns of gossip. A new umbrella in sunshine brings joy and plenty.
You see ashes. Bitter changes are coming; hold on and avoid hasty decisions. For a farmer — a poor harvest; for a trader — failed deals. For parents — worries over headstrong children.
You go bankrupt. Your affairs may partly falter; stay away from risky investments. Look after your energy and clear head: tiredness gets in the way of good decisions.

You see beads. Influential people will take notice of you. Counting beads — quiet joy and contentment. Stringing beads — support from wealthy people. Scattering beads — losing respect among your acquaintances.
You hear bells tolling. Troubling news may come from far away. You may learn of some wrong done, and it will upset you. Joyful, ringing bells mean a happy victory over a rival.

You are reading and studying books with interest. Pleasant pursuits, honour and prosperity lie ahead. Working through a difficult book means well-earned recognition. Children with their books mean harmony and good behaviour at home. Old books warn you to stay away from anything wrong. For an author, seeing their book in print means a hard road to readers.
You are borrowing money. Expect losses and lean times: do not live beyond your means. If someone borrows from you, help will come when you need it, and true friends will stand by you.

You see large, beautiful buildings with green lawns. A long, comfortable life and travels to distant lands. Small new houses mean a happy home and profitable ventures. Old, dirty buildings mean low energy and cooling in love and work.

You have plenty of cash, but all of it is borrowed. People will respect you, but those close to you will find you calculating and cold; be warmer to others. For a young woman, spending borrowed money means a deception will come to light and she may lose a dear friend.

You are bound in chains. An unfair burden is about to be placed on your shoulders. Breaking the chains means you will free yourself from an unpleasant task or commitment. Seeing chains means slander and envy. Others in chains face hard times.

You play chess. Your affairs may stall and the company around you may feel dull; keep an eye on your health. Losing the game — petty but annoying worries. Winning — you will overcome whatever holds you back.
You see glowing coals. Bright coals promise pleasure and many happy changes. Holding the coals yourself — pure joy. Dead, cold coals — troubles and disappointments.

You see gold coins. Gold coins mean great prosperity, travel and vivid impressions. Silver coins — discord at home, but if they are clean, shiny and in your own hands — good luck. Copper coins — hard work and low spirits. For a young woman getting a silver coin from her sweetheart — a breakup.
Confetti in a crowd blocks your view. If you chase fun first and leave your duties for later, you could lose a lot. Do what you must first — the party won't run away.

You hold counterfeit money. You will have trouble with a quarrelsome, worthless person. Whether you receive fake money or pay with it, the dream always warns of something bad. Check who you are dealing with.
You see curtains on the windows. Unwelcome visitors will bring you worry and unhappiness. Dirty or torn curtains mean ugly quarrels and reproaches.

You own diamonds. A very lucky dream: honour and recognition. For a young woman, receiving diamonds from her beloved promises a happy, respected marriage. Losing diamonds and not finding them means serious setbacks and hardship.
You are throwing dice. Risky money ventures will bring you grief. Look after your health. For a young woman to see her beloved playing dice means he is not worthy of her.

You are digging the ground. You will never be in need, but life will take hard work. Digging up something shiny means a turn for the better. If water fills the hole, things will not go your way no matter how hard you try.

You are covered in dust. Other people's mistakes will hurt your affairs a little. If you manage to brush the dust off sensibly, you will make up the loss. For a young woman, the dream advises caring for the relationship: her beloved may be drawn to someone else.
You arrange your china. You will have a cosy home and run it wisely and thriftily. Painting china — quiet joys at home. Take care of what you build with your own hands.

You see heaps of garbage. Beware of rumours and stay out of shady dealings. Clearing or taking out the garbage: getting rid of what weighs you down. For a woman, the dream advises not trusting those who speak badly of her.
You see precious stones. A happy fate awaits you in both love and work. Value what you already have: real treasures are often close by.

You look through a pane of glass. Be ready for some hopes not to come true right away. Seeing clearly through a window pane: you'll find work, but under someone else's direction. Cloudy glass: an awkward position. Breaking glass dishes or a window: an unlucky end to something you started. Receiving cut glass as a gift: you'll be admired for your intelligence and talent.

You hold gold in your hands. You'll be unusually lucky in everything you take on. Finding gold: your abilities will put you ahead. Losing gold: through carelessness you could miss a great chance. Finding a vein of gold: an honourable but troublesome role will come your way.

You are wearing handcuffs. Ill-wishers will pester you and get in your way. Seeing others in handcuffs: you'll overcome those who oppress you. Breaking the handcuffs: you'll escape the traps set for you.

You spill ink on your clothes. Envious people will play petty tricks on you. Do not take them to heart. Ink on your fingers: do not give in to jealousy or the urge to hurt someone. Red ink: a serious trouble. Bottles of ink: rivals and failed plans. A young woman seeing ink: a rival may slander her.

You see iron. A hard time is ahead. Be ready for worries and hold on. An iron weight pressing on you: anxiety and losses. Rusty iron: shortage of money and disappointment. Red-hot iron: your energy is going the wrong way, so aim it wisely. Striking with iron: do not be harsh with those who depend on you.

You are ironing clothes. Home comforts and order in your affairs are waiting for you. Burning your hands on the iron: look after your health and do not give in to jealousy. Scorching the clothes: a rival will appear and stir up suspicion. The iron is too cold: your home is short of warmth and affection.

You see jewels. Joy and wealth are waiting for you. Wearing jewels: high standing and dreams come true. Finding jewels: quick and brilliant success. Losing them: beware of flatterers. Broken or tarnished jewellery: disappointment and friends who let you down.

You are knitting. A quiet, peaceful home awaits you, where loved ones care for you and make you happy. A young woman knitting: a quick and happy wedding. Being in a knitting mill: thrift and steady growth. A run-down mill: setbacks in work and love.

You do the laundry. There will be a struggle, but in the end you will win prosperity. If the clothes come out clean, your efforts will bring full happiness. If they don't, money won't bring joy. A laundry worker calling at your home tells you to look after your health and your valuables.

You lend someone money. You may find it hard to pay your own bills. Lending things means generosity that may leave you short. Refusing to lend means you will protect your interests and keep friends' respect. Being offered a loan yourself means prosperity and close friendships.

You haul heavy luggage. Hassles and unpleasant company lie ahead. Carrying your own luggage reminds you not to let your worries blind you to others' troubles. Losing your luggage means a failed venture or family quarrels, and for single people a broken engagement.
You see matches. Prosperity and change will come when you least expect them. Striking a match in the dark means unexpected news and good fortune.

You find money. Small worries are ahead, but plenty of happiness too, followed by changes. Receiving gold means great prosperity. Losing money brings gloomy hours at home. Counting money and finding some missing warns of trouble with payments. Saving money promises wealth and comfort. A heap of money shows happiness is within reach.
You hear beautiful music. Joy and prosperity await you. Harsh, jarring music warns of trouble with unruly children and discord at home.
You see nails. A lot of work for a modest reward lies ahead. Buying or selling nails means honest work, even if simple. Rusty or bent nails tell you to look after your health and be careful at work.
You dream of numbers. Unsettled affairs will make you uneasy, so put your accounts in order. The dream advises checking your bills and not making money decisions in a hurry.

You see a freshly painted house. The plan you have in mind will succeed. Painting yourself means you are happy with your work. Paint on your clothes means someone's careless criticism will upset you. Beautiful paintings warn that not all that glitters is gold: some friends may be less sincere than they seem.

You have been poisoned. You will soon feel someone’s painful influence. Throwing the poison away — by sheer will you will change an unpleasant situation. A rival or enemy is poisoned — you will overcome obstacles. Your loved ones are poisoned — expect harm from an unexpected side. Recovering from poison — success after worry.

You are reading. You will excel at a task that seems difficult. Seeing others read — your friends will be kind and well disposed toward you. Discussing what you read — your gift with words will grow. Blurry text that makes no sense — worries and disappointments.

You rent a house. You will sign new agreements, and they will prove profitable. Paying rent — your finances will be in good shape. Failing to rent out your property — business will stall for a while. Being unable to pay rent — income will drop, and fun will bring little joy.

You see ruins. Plans may fall apart: a broken engagement, trouble at work, and low energy are possible. Ancient ruins: a long journey and a long-held dream come true, though the joy will be mixed with missing a faraway friend.
You are weighing something on scales. A sense of fairness will guide you, and your prosperity will grow. For a young woman, weighing her partner means he will prove solid and faithful.

You see a pair of scissors. Jealousy, reproaches and quarrels between partners are possible, and work may stall. Sharpening scissors: you will have to do a task you dislike. Breaking them: a quarrel and maybe a breakup. Losing them: you will try to dodge dull chores.
You are sewing new clothes. Peace and harmony at home will crown your wishes. Patient work with your own hands will bring comfort and warmth.
You see silver. Do not count on money alone to bring you happiness and peace. Finding silver coins: do not judge others too quickly. Silverware: worries and unmet wishes.

You are sleeping in a clean, fresh bed. Peace and the goodwill of those you love await you. Sleeping in an odd, uncomfortable place: look after your health; plans may fall through. Sleeping next to a small child: family joy and love returned. Watching others sleep: you will overcome every obstacle to win someone's heart.
You see smoke. Doubts and fears will trouble you. Choking on smoke: dangerous people are using flattery to fool you; do not trust sweet talk.
You see soap. Friendships will bring you interesting meetings and good times. For a young woman, making soap means solid, reliable prosperity.
You sweep the floor. Your loved ones will appreciate your care, and home will feel cozy and happy. Seeing the floor needs sweeping and not doing it means disappointments. Don't put off chores.

You pay your taxes. You will manage to push back the bad influences around you. Others paying taxes means you'll have to ask friends for help. Being unable to pay means experiments and new ventures won't succeed for now.

You find yourself underground. Guard your good name and your money: both are easy to lose right now. Living in an underground home threatens your reputation. Riding the subway points to an odd venture that will bring worry.
You see new toys. New, unbroken toys mean joy in the family. Broken toys mean sorrow at home. Children playing with toys mean a happy marriage. Giving toys away means acquaintances may ignore you.

You are very rich. You will gather your strength and tackle things decisively, and that leads to success. Seeing others wealthy means friends will help you in hard times. For a young woman, being among rich people points to high goals and someone who will help her reach them.

You are writing something. Be careful: you could make a costly mistake. Seeing writing means you will be reproached for carelessness. Trying to read strange writing warns you not to start any new risky ventures for now.

You see a clean, happy baby. Love returned and many warm friends are waiting for you. A crying baby — save your strength; small upsets are possible. A baby walking alone — independence. For a woman, nursing a baby — do not trust blindly, even those closest to you.

You are at a ball where elegant people dance to lovely music. A very good dream: joy and good fortune. You feel sad at the ball and no one pays you attention — worry about your loved ones; support them.

You see a baptism. Be more restrained in arguments so as not to hurt your friends. Being baptised yourself — do not give up who you are for other people's approval. A baptism dream often speaks of a choice between duty to others and your own wishes.
You fight in a battle. A struggle with difficulties lies ahead, but victory comes in the end. Losing the battle — other people's bad deals will spoil your plans.

An angry person is beating you. Expect quarrels and discord in the family. If you are the one beating a child, you are taking unfair advantage of someone weaker; be gentler with those who depend on you.

You see an old beggar. Time to sort out your money: without care you could lose a lot. Giving to a beggar shows you feel cramped in your present life and want change. Refusing a beggar is a bad sign: be more generous. Gossip may be going around, so guard your reputation.

You are celebrating your birthday. For the young, money troubles and deceit; for older people, lasting worries. Be careful. Receiving birthday presents means great achievements, and promotion for working people. Giving presents means small signs of respect and attention.

You go into partnership with someone. Your money matters will be unsteady, so don't invest your last savings. A partner who drops and mixes up goods warns that his carelessness will cost you, but if you call him out in time, you will recover much. Ending an unpleasant partnership means things will work out the way you want. Parting with a good partner brings worrying news.
You are having fun at a carnival. An unusual pleasure or a break is coming soon. A carnival with masks and clowns means discord at home, slow business and unreturned feelings.

You walk into a vast cathedral. You will rise in life and be surrounded by wise and learned people. Looking at a cathedral from outside without entering means envy and longing for the unreachable will trouble you.

You walk through a beautiful, well-kept cemetery. Unexpected good news about someone you were worried about, and justice restored. For a mother, carrying fresh flowers to a cemetery means good health for her family. Children picking flowers and chasing butterflies among the graves mean happy changes and good health. An old, overgrown cemetery means feeling lonely; seek warmth from those close to you.
You see a champion. Your dignity and honesty will win you the warm friendship of someone who matters to you. Hold on to your principles — they are what will draw loyal people to you.
You hear a choir. Gloom and discontent will give way to cheerful surroundings. For a young woman, singing in a choir means jealousy: her sweetheart may pay attention to others.

You see a church. A pleasure you have long looked forward to may disappoint you. Entering a gloomy church — a sad occasion and low spirits. A chapel — disagreements among friends and changes at work. Young people entering a chapel — beware of insincere love.

You see a coffin. A hard stretch lies ahead: debts, setbacks at work and sadness at home. A coffin moving on its own — sorrow and joy will come mixed together. Sitting on a coffin — look after your health and avoid quarrels; you will regret how you treated a friend.
You see your cousin. Disappointments and setbacks lie ahead. Warm letters with a cousin — a falling-out between families. Keep the peace among relatives and stay out of other people's quarrels.

You keep company with a criminal. Unscrupulous people will try to use your friendship for their own ends. A criminal fleeing the law — you will learn other people's secrets, and that will make you a target; keep your mouth shut.

You see a cross. Trouble lies ahead — put your affairs in order in advance. Someone carrying a cross — you will be asked to help with a good cause. A crucifix — trouble that will touch others besides you. Kissing a crucifix — you will accept a trial calmly. For a young woman wearing a crucifix — modesty and kindness will bring her love and good fortune.

You see a well-dressed crowd at a party. Pleasant time with friends awaits you. The party is spoiled — disappointment and a cooling friendship. A crowd in the street — a busy, successful period. Trying to be heard over a crowd — you will push your interests forward. Many people in dark clothes — small upsets.

You see a crown. Your way of life will change: you will travel far from home and make new connections. Wearing a crown yourself — take care of your belongings. Crowning someone else — you deserve respect. Watching a coronation — friendship with influential people.

You are dancing. Unexpected good luck is coming your way. Children dancing promise a happy family and a cosy home. Older people dancing mean better prospects at work. For the young, the dream brings easy tasks and many joys.
You see your daughter. Annoyances will give way to joy and harmony. If your daughter upsets or disobeys you in the dream, expect irritation and discontent.

You see a corpse. The dream foretells sad news from people far away and a downturn in your affairs. A body dressed in black — a tangled, difficult matter. A battlefield covered in bodies — strife and general discontent. A dead animal — stagnation at work and low energy.

A dentist is working on your teeth. You will come to doubt the honesty of someone you deal with. Seeing a dentist treat a young woman's teeth means a scandal among people you know will soon shock you.

You see a doctor. Any worries or ailments you have will soon pass. The doctor looks anxious — your trials may drag on, so take care of yourself. For a young woman, the dream advises not to waste her energy and beauty on empty amusements.
You see a fairy. A happy sign for everyone: joy and bright events lie ahead. A fairy usually appears as a beautiful woman or a happy child; trust your good feeling.

You see your family. A close and cheerful family in a dream points to good health and an easy, comfortable life. If the family is quarrelling or someone is ill, expect a gloomy spell and disappointment; smooth things over early.

You say goodbye to someone. Not the kindest dream: you may hear unpleasant news about people who are far away. For a young woman, saying goodbye to her sweetheart hints that his feelings are cooling. If she feels no sadness, others will soon comfort her.

You see your father. A tricky situation lies ahead, and wise advice will help you get out of it. If your late father appears, your affairs are heavy going and need careful handling. For a young woman, it is a hint to check how sincere her partner is.
You see your father-in-law. Arguments with friends or relatives may come up. If he looks healthy and cheerful, family relations will be warm and peaceful.

You are in a fight. Unpleasant clashes with rivals lie ahead, and legal disputes are possible. Beating your attacker: courage and persistence will bring you success. Losing the fight: you may lose something you consider yours. Watching others fight: you are wasting time and money.
You see a firefighter. Your friends are loyal and will not let you down. If the firefighter is hurt, a close friend may need your support; pay them extra attention.
You see a fisherman. Times of greater wealth than you have ever known are coming. Be patient: like a good catch, luck comes to those who know how to wait.

You see your friends healthy and happy. Good news from them, or a meeting with them, is coming soon. A friend looking worn out may need your help. A friend standing like a statue on a hill: you will move ahead yet keep your convictions. Shaking hands with someone who wronged you as they leave sadly: a rift with a close friend.

You are at a funeral on a sunny day. Your loved ones will be well, and there may soon be a wedding in the family. A funeral in rain and gloomy weather means bad news from afar and slow business. Sad rites and grieving faces point to difficult surroundings.

You see a ghost. Be careful with new acquaintances and don't rush into partnerships with strangers. The ghost of a late friend: a long trip in unpleasant company. A ghost speaks to you: beware of a trap set by ill-wishers. The ghost of someone living: keep your affairs under your own eye. A female ghost floating across the sky: success in studies and unexpected wealth.

A giant suddenly appears in front of you. A serious struggle with rivals lies ahead. If the giant runs away from you: prosperity and good health. If he blocks your way: a rival may get the upper hand, so be patient.
You see a healthy, cheerful girl. Good prospects and family joys lie ahead. If the girl is thin and pale, someone in your family may need care; pay attention to your loved ones.

You see a freshly dug grave. The dream warns that you may suffer for other people's mistakes; be careful in your dealings. Digging a grave and finishing it: you'll overcome your opponents. If the sun is shining as well, good will come out of the trouble. Looking into an empty grave: disappointment and friends drifting away.

You are sitting at the hairdresser's. You may get dragged into a noisy story because of someone else's indiscretion. For a woman, having her hair dyed: ill-wishers will try to hurt her reputation, but she'll stand firm. Having her hair styled: don't chase trifles.

You shake someone's hand. You will be loved and respected for your kindness. Shaking hands with an important person: honor and goodwill from strangers. Having to reach up to do it: rivalry. Someone's hands are dirty: there are enemies among your seeming friends.
You celebrate a holiday. Interesting new people will soon be your guests. A young woman not enjoying the holiday: she will doubt her own charm while trying to win a friend back from a rival.

An astrologer draws up your horoscope. Unexpected changes and a long trip are coming, and maybe an important new acquaintance. Being shown the stars as your fate is read: where luck seems to be waiting, disappointment may come instead.

You see your husband cheerful and handsome. Your home will fill with happiness, and bright prospects lie ahead. Your husband leaves you without explanation: some bitterness, then an unexpected reconciliation. Your husband looks pale and tired: look after the family's health. He is in love with someone else: he is getting bored, so bring new life to your relationship. An unmarried woman sees herself married: work on yourself before looking for a partner.

You stand before a judge. A dispute will be settled by law and fairly. The case goes your way: the dispute will end well. It goes against you: consider whether you are the one in the wrong, and set things right.

You are crowned king. You will rise above your peers and colleagues. Just seeing a king: ambition drives you and you are fighting with all your might. A king scolds you: you will be reminded of a duty you neglected. Receiving a king's favour: high standing and a happy union.

You are in a lawsuit. Enemies are trying to turn people against you. If you know your claim is dishonest, don't try to take what isn't yours. Studying law means a fast rise in your chosen field. For a woman, this dream warns of gossip and hidden enemies among friends.
You deal with a lawyer. Be careful: a careless step could bring you unpleasant talk. For a young woman, this dream advises guarding her reputation and giving no reason for gossip.

You tell a lie to escape punishment. You may treat an innocent person unfairly. Lying to protect a friend means unfair criticism, but you will rise above it. Hearing others lie means someone is trying to trap you. Being called a liar means trouble from deceitful people.

A mail carrier brings you letters. Unwelcome news will come soon. Hearing the mail carrier's whistle means an unexpected visitor. A mail carrier passing by without your mail means disappointment and sadness. Handing letters to him warns of envy. Chatting with a mail carrier warns you not to get drawn into shady affairs.

You see a handsome, well-built man. You will enjoy life to the full and become wealthy. An ugly, sour-faced man means disappointments and tangled affairs. For a woman, a handsome man foretells honors, while an ugly one means trouble from a false friend.

You see a miser. Selfishness will make true happiness hard to find, and love may disappoint you. Being miserly yourself means your arrogance will push people away. Friends turning out to be misers means others' nagging requests will wear you down. For a woman helped by a miser, the dream promises love and wealth through her wits and tact.

You see a monk. Expect some family disagreements and tiring trips. For a young woman, the dream warns of gossip and deceit. Becoming a monk yourself tells you to look after your health and belongings.
A monster is chasing you. A hard stretch with some sorrows lies ahead, so gather your strength. Slaying a monster means you will deal with your rivals and reach a high position.
You see your mother-in-law. After a serious falling-out, a pleasant reconciliation will come. Arguing with her means quarrelsome, unfeeling people will annoy you.

You witness a murder. Other people's wrongdoing will upset you, and your affairs will stall for a while. Committing murder yourself means you are getting into a shady venture that could stain your name. Being murdered means rivals are secretly working against you.
You see your nephew. If he looks handsome and healthy, a pleasant income awaits you. If he looks unwell, expect disappointment and discomfort.
You see your niece. Unexpected trials and a lot of needless worry lie ahead. Don't take everything to heart: most of the worries will turn out to be empty.

A nurse is staying in your home. Look after your family's health and avoid visits where you're not welcome. A nurse leaving your house promises good health in the family. For a young woman, being a nurse means people will respect her for her kindness and devotion.

You are having fun at a party. You will see how much good there is in life. A party full of quarrels means your joy will be clouded. A group of strangers attacking you for money warns that rivals will band together against you; if you get away unharmed, you will beat them in work and in love.

You see a pickpocket. Someone who wishes you ill will manage to cause you trouble and loss. Your pocket is picked — someone envies you; keep your affairs to yourself so you do not lose a friend. You pick someone’s pocket — rude behavior will push a companion away.

You see pirates. Beware of false friends: they are plotting against you. You are a pirate — you risk losing the respect of your friends and old circle. Your beloved turns out to be a pirate — they are not who they claim to be. Pirates capture you — someone is trying to lure you away from home with lies.
You are praying. A setback threatens, but with determined effort you can turn it aside. Seeing others pray carries the same sign: a difficulty is coming, so prepare for it in advance.

You see a priest. The dream asks you to look honestly at your own weaknesses and mistakes. A priest in the pulpit — worries and health concerns. Confessing to a priest — embarrassment and sorrow. Falling in love with a priest — beware of deceit and an insincere admirer.

You see convicts. Seeing convicts means troubles and sad news. Being a convict yourself — one matter will worry you, but you will sort it all out. For a young woman seeing her sweetheart in prison clothes — she should take a closer look at his feelings.

You are quarreling. The dream foretells unhappiness and heated arguments. For a young woman — a serious falling-out. For a couple — long disagreements; be patient with each other. Hearing others quarrel — sluggish business.
You see a queen. Your ventures will succeed. The queen looks old or worn out — disappointment in your pleasures.
You are in a race. Others will be after the same things you are working for. Winning the race — you will beat your competitors.
You are rescued from danger. Trouble will threaten you, but you will get off with a small loss. Rescuing others — you will be respected for your good deeds.
You see a riot in the street. Your affairs will disappoint you; do not rush important decisions. Being caught in the crowd: stay out of other people's fights and keep calm.

You see sailors. Long and exciting journeys await you. For a young woman, seeing sailors: a light flirtation could part her from her partner. Being a sailor herself: a reckless prank could cost her a faithful friend.
You are the subject of gossip. You are not choosy about your company; your affairs may slow down after this dream. For a young woman, discussing a scandal: do not trust someone who only seems honest.

You are at school. Success awaits you in study, creative work or writing. Being a child at school again: hard times will make you long for the simple joys of the past. Teaching a class: you strive for knowledge, but must first take care of daily needs. Visiting your old school: present worries weigh on you; give yourself a rest.

You see your son handsome and caring. Your son will make you proud and achieve great things. Your son hurt or unwell: worries ahead; pay more attention to your loved ones. For a mother, seeing her son fall into a well: distress; rescuing him: the danger will pass unexpectedly.

You meet a stranger from a far-off land. If you like them — good health and pleasant people around you. An unpleasant stranger — disappointments. You are the foreigner in a distant land — lasting friendships.

You see a tailor. An upcoming trip will bring some fuss. Prepare in advance. Arguing with a tailor means a plan won't meet expectations. A tailor taking your measurements means arguments and disagreements.
