You see a teacher. You will enjoy learning and quiet, peaceful pastimes. Being a teacher yourself: you will reach the success you want in work and creative pursuits.

You see tombs. This means sadness and disappointments at work. Don't lose hope: the sorrow will pass. Seeing your own tomb means taking care of your health and not taking setbacks to heart. Reading inscriptions on tombs means unpleasant duties.
You see a traitor. Enemies will try to harm you. Keep important things to yourself. Being called a traitor or becoming one means your fun won't bring joy.

You win a victory. You will fend off your opponents' attacks, and luck will be with you in love. The more confident the victory in the dream, the more firmly you will stand your ground in waking life.

You go visiting. A pleasant occasion is coming soon. An unpleasant visit means spiteful people may spoil your fun. A friend visiting you brings good news. A sad, tired guest means small disappointments. A pale guest dressed in black or white is a hint to mind your health and take care.
A waiter serves you. A friend will treat you to a pleasant time. A rude or sloppy waiter means uninvited guests will take advantage of your hospitality.
You see yourself as a widow. Spiteful tongues may cause you plenty of trouble. For a man, marrying a widow means a cherished plan may not live up to his hopes.
You see witches. You and others will set off on merry adventures, but you may feel embarrassed afterwards. Witches advancing on you point to difficulties at work and disappointment at home.

Someone gives you advice. You will grow more honest and firm in your principles and win independence through honest work. Seeking legal advice — doubtful points will appear in your affairs; check everything carefully.

Someone accuses you of something. Watch your words: you may be tempted to pass on gossip, and it will turn against you. You accuse someone yourself — quarrels with people who depend on you and a blow to your pride.

You watch acrobats perform. Other people's fears will keep you from a risky plan. You do the tricks yourself — you will have to answer for a scandal while rivals mock you. Female acrobats — someone may spread nasty rumours about you.

You see an actress. Your life will be full of pleasure and good luck for now. You are an actor yourself — you will work hard, but gladly. Falling for an actor or actress — you lean more toward fun than hard work. A performer in trouble — you will gladly help a friend out of debt. For a young woman, marrying an actor — regret will follow the glamour.
You adopt a child. A move or change of home is coming, and it is worth preparing for well. Seeing an adopted child or adoptive parent — money will come to you through other people's plans.

You see an altar in a temple. The altar warns you against a mistake and calls you to admit when you are wrong. A priest at the altar — disputes and trouble at home and at work. A wedding at the altar — sorrow among your friends.

Someone attacks you from an ambush. A hidden danger is close by; heed the warnings and it will not catch you. You lie in ambush to take revenge — the dream warns you against treating your friends unfairly.

You see an angel. Changes are coming into your life, and your soul will be stirred. A joyful dream — good news about your loved ones and an unexpected inheritance. An uneasy dream — beware of gossip about love or money. For a kind person, an angel is a comfort.
You see someone being arrested. You want change, but fear of failure holds back new ventures. The person resists the police — you will gladly see a new project through to the end.

You see a killer. This is a warning: secret ill-wishers may cause you losses. The killer attacks you — hard times ahead; you will not beat every trouble at once. A killer standing over a bloodied person — trouble for you yourself.
You see your aunt. Someone may sharply criticise something you did, and it will upset you. Your aunt is smiling and happy — a small disagreement will soon give way to joy.

You defeat your enemies. You will overcome every difficulty at work, and things will take off. If enemies slander you, be extremely careful in important matters. If they get the better of you, a run of bad luck lies ahead.

You escape from harm or an accident. Usually a good dream: danger will pass you by. Escaping from confinement means hard work will lift you up in life. Trying to escape and failing means enemies will try to slander and cheat you.

You receive an inheritance. You will easily get what you want. Becoming heir to property: take care of what you already have and get ready for new responsibilities; pleasant surprises are possible too.
You see an old man or an old woman. If their face looks troubled, heavy worries await you. If the old person is calm and kind, expect wise advice and quiet support.

You comfort orphans. Others' troubles will move you, and you will give up some of your own pleasures for them. If the orphans are your relatives, new duties will enter your life and you will drift apart from friends for a while.

You see your uncle. Some less than cheerful news will soon arrive. A downcast uncle in a repeated dream points to a rift with relatives, though not for good. Quarrelling with your uncle means tension in the family; look after your health and peace at home.

You see something very beautiful. Beauty in a dream is one of the kindest signs: joy and good luck lie ahead. A beautiful woman brings pleasure and profitable work. A beautiful, healthy child means love returned and a happy union.

You are left all alone. It will be hard to make plans for the future; you will need to find your footing again. You abandon someone yourself — troubles will pile up around you. Leaving your home — a risky bet will go badly. Abandoning a ship but reaching the shore — your affairs will stay safe.

Someone cheats you. You will meet cunning people who will try to block your way to success. Cheated in business — double-check every agreement. Cheated in a game — a misunderstanding may lead to a quarrel with your loved one.

You see your brothers full of energy. You will rejoice in your own good luck or in theirs. Brothers in need or asking for help mean worry about loved ones and hardships you will have to face together.

Burglars are searching you. Be careful with strangers: you have dangerous ill-wishers. Burglars breaking into your home or workplace mean someone will try to damage your reputation, but courage will protect you. After this dream, be extra careful on the road and at home.
You are being buried alive. You are close to a serious mistake that rivals could use against you. If you are rescued from the grave, persistence will help you set things right.

You see beautiful children. Prosperity and plenty of joy await you. Children studying or working — calm and comfortable times. Playing with children — success in your affairs and in love. Upset children — beware of people who only pretend to be friends. Your child seems unwell in the dream — it asks you to give them more attention and warmth.

You see Christ. Many peaceful days lie ahead, full of plenty, knowledge and joy. The Christ child with the wise men — peace and contentment. Christ in the garden of Gethsemane — longing for loved ones far away and a hunger for change. Christ driving the traders from the temple — honest work will defeat ill-wishers.

You are in great danger but escape. You will step out of the shadows and win recognition and respect. If you fail to escape or are hurt, expect losses at work and trouble at home. For people in love, the dream warns of cooling feelings.

You fail. The dream warns of mistakes in your affairs: fix them before they turn into real losses. If someone in love dreams of being turned down, it means the opposite: they are already loved and just need to be bolder. For a young woman, the dream advises making better use of her opportunities.

Your fortune is being told, or you tell one. You are weighing a tangled matter; don't rush to say yes. For a young woman, fortune-telling foretells a choice between two admirers; she should find out more about each of them.

You are giving birth to a baby. Great joy and an unexpected gain are coming. For a married woman, this dream promises happiness in the family. For a single woman, it says be careful in new relationships and do not trust too quickly.
People are gossiping about you. Oddly enough, this points to a pleasant surprise. Getting caught up in gossip yourself: an awkward situation from trusting casual acquaintances too much.
You talk with your grandparents. Tough obstacles lie ahead, but good advice will help you overcome them. Listen to the experience of your elders: their words hold a hint for you right now.
You hate someone. Be careful: in the heat of the moment you could hurt someone, and the grudge will cost you. If you are hated unfairly, sincere and helpful friends will be by your side.

You rise up to heaven. A reward for your work may not bring the joy you expect. Look for happiness beyond success. Climbing to heaven on a ladder: a big rise, though peace of mind will need finding on its own. Being in paradise among friends: you will get through losses and make peace with them through wisdom. Seeing the Heavenly City: your soul is calm, and troubles will barely touch you.

You find yourself in hell. Temptations are coming that could cost you dearly. Do not give in to easy money or dubious pleasures. Seeing friends in hell: heavy worries and bad news about someone you know. Crying in hell: friends will not be able to pull you out of a trap, so rely on yourself.

You are learning something new. You will be drawn to knowledge, and if you use your time well you will go far. Entering a university or school means rising from obscurity and earning more. Seeing learned people means interesting, influential friends. For a woman, it promises success for her ambitions.
You achieve your goal by magic. Pleasant surprises are coming your way. Seeing others work magic means profitable changes. Meeting a magician means interesting trips and good returns on your efforts.
You see your neighbors. A lot of time will be lost to pointless arguments and gossip, so don't get drawn in. Sad or angry neighbors foretell disagreements and quarrels.
You celebrate New Year. Prosperity and happy hopes in love and family await you. Greeting the New Year tired and joyless tells you not to rush into promises or an engagement.
You hear good news. Your affairs will go well, and pleasant people will be around you. Bad news in a dream means the opposite: difficulties and discord.

You find yourself in paradise. You have loyal friends ready to help. The dream brings good hopes to those about to set off on a long journey. To parents it promises fine, obedient children. If you are ill or in trouble, it foretells a quick recovery and luck. To lovers it promises wealth and faithfulness. Setting off for paradise and getting lost warns that a tempting venture may disappoint.

You are playing cards with friends for fun. Long-held hopes will come true, and small troubles will go away. Playing for money means serious difficulties. Losing means meeting enemies. Winning means you will prove yourself right, though not easily. Diamonds mean wealth, hearts mean loyalty and a cosy home, clubs mean a demanding partner.

You are in a rage, shouting and smashing things. Quarrels lie ahead, and your friends may get hurt. Seeing others in a rage — poor conditions at work and discord in your social life. Your beloved in a rage — a sour note and misunderstandings in your relationship.

You take revenge on someone. Resentment is pushing you toward harsh acts that could cost you friends. Taking revenge yourself: keep your anger in check or it will bring trouble. Someone takes revenge on you: watch out for enemies.

You hear gunshots. Selfishness may bring discord to a couple, and carelessness may bring setbacks at work. Being shot: friends will suddenly turn on you, but later you will fully make up. For a young woman, seeing her partner with a gun: a serious falling-out.

You hear singing. High spirits, cheerful friends and good news from far away await you. Singing yourself while everything promises happiness: someone's envy will creep into your joy. A sad song: your affairs will take an unexpected turn.

You see soldiers marching. You will get ahead of your rivals and rise higher; just do not overindulge. Wounded soldiers: other people's troubles may complicate your affairs; do not let pity overrule your judgment. Being a brave soldier yourself: your ideals will come true.

You steal something. Bad luck and gossip are coming. Guard your good name. Being accused of stealing means you'll be misunderstood, but it will end in your favor. Catching a thief means you'll beat your enemies. Being chased as a thief means setbacks at work.

You are swearing. Annoying obstacles will appear at work. Watch your words. Swearing in front of your family means trouble at home caused by your own behavior. For someone in love, it advises not to give in to groundless suspicion.

You are talking with someone. Soon you'll have worries about your family and fuss at work. Hearing others talk loudly means you'll be blamed for meddling. Feeling that people are talking about you means you should guard your health and reputation.
You are reading the Bible. A pure, simple joy will be offered to you; accept it. Mocking the Bible means a friend will try to talk you into a temptation you have long resisted; stand firm.

You see someone who has died and talk with them. This is a warning dream: be careful with your affairs and agreements. A late father warns against risky deals. A late mother asks you to drive away gloom and grudges. A late brother or friend means someone will soon ask for your help. If the dead ask you for a promise, heed their advice.

You see the devil. Risky adventures lie ahead, and you will need some cunning to keep your good name. Killing the devil: you will leave bad company and rise higher. He comes as wealth or power: do not misuse your influence. Shielding yourself from him: you will break free from selfish pleasures and help others.

The police try to arrest you for something you did not do. You will successfully outrun your rivals. The arrest is deserved — a run of bad luck. Seeing police on patrol — sharp ups and downs in your affairs.

You speak with the Pope. High honors await you. Seeing the Pope without speaking to him — you will have to bow to someone else’s will. The Pope looks sad or displeased — guard against bad habits and sorrow.

You see triplets. Something you feared would fail will end in success. For a man, dreaming his wife has triplets means a long dispute will end well. Newborn triplets crying mean quarrels that will be quickly settled. For a young woman, having triplets means disappointment in love but also wealth.
You see twins. Your affairs will be secure, and love and loyalty will fill your home. Sickly twins point to disappointment and sorrow.
Someone uses violence against you. Your opponents may gain the upper hand; stay alert. If you are the one being violent, harshness in your dealings may cost you money and respect.

You hear voices. Calm, pleasant voices point to reconciliation and good relations. Harsh, angry voices mean disappointments. Weeping voices warn you to hold back anger so you do not hurt a friend. A voice from above inspires you to grow and earns you the respect of worthy people. An anxious voice calling you is a sign to take care of yourself and your loved ones.

You dream of war. Your affairs will run into difficulties, and there will be discord and turmoil at home. For a young woman, seeing her partner go to war means she will hear unpleasant news about him. Your country losing a war points to upheaval in your affairs. Dreaming of victory means busy work and harmony in the family.

You are working hard. You will focus on the task and earn well-deserved success. Seeing others at work means hopeful circumstances will gather around you. Looking for work points to an unexpected turn that will benefit you.

You see your mother at home. What you have started will bear good fruit. Talking with your mother brings good news about what worries you. Your mother calling you means you have taken a wrong turn, so review your affairs. Your mother crying tells you to take care of yourself and visit her. A sad or worn-out mother foretells sadness.

You see your parents cheerful and healthy. There will be harmony and pleasant people in your life, and your work and love will thrive. Your parents happy in your home promise pleasant changes. Parents who have passed away appearing in a dream ask you to be more careful in your affairs. Pale parents or parents dressed in black foretell disappointments. Sad or unwell parents warn that you may miss good chances.
You wear a bracelet, a gift from a loved one or a friend. A wedding soon, or a strong and happy union. Losing a bracelet means small losses and annoyance. Finding one means a valuable gain.

You are a bride, happily dressing for your wedding. A pleasant surprise that will delight you. If dressing feels joyless, your hopes may not come true. Kissing a bride means friends will make up. A bride kissing you means good health and unexpected luck for your sweetheart. A bride looking tired and pale means success will not satisfy you.

You are getting divorced. A warning dream: something is missing in your relationship; bring more warmth into your home. For a woman, a dream of divorce advises looking more closely at a partner's faithfulness.

You hug someone. Both love and work may let you down. Do not expect too much from people. A woman hugging a man: she should be choosier about who courts her. Hugging someone other than your partner: guard the trust between you.

You kiss your mother. Success in your affairs, respect and love from friends are waiting for you. Children kissing: happy family get-togethers. Kissing your loved one in the light: your intentions are honest; in the dark: beware of dubious affairs. A rival kisses your loved one: you risk losing their affection. Kissing an enemy: making up with an offended friend.

You are wearing a ring. New ventures are ahead, and they will succeed. A broken ring: quarrels in marriage or a parting for lovers. For a young woman, receiving a ring means her worries about her partner will end; he will be devoted to her. Seeing rings on others: growing prosperity and new friends.

You have a rival. You are too slow to stand up for yourself and may lose favor with important people. A rival gets the better of you: you have grown too comfortable and let things slide. You beat your rival: a step up and a good choice of partner. For a young woman, the dream says to cherish the love she already has.

You see your sweetheart. If they're warm and attractive in the dream, your choice will bring you joy and pride. If they look different than usual, doubts may arise before the wedding. If they're ill or sad, joy will be mixed with sorrow.

You send a valentine. Do not miss a good opportunity: it is easy to overlook right now. For a young woman, receiving a valentine points to an ardent but not very dependable admirer her family will not approve of.

You attend a wedding. An event is coming that will bring bitterness and delay your success. A cheerful, bright wedding means the opposite: joy and luck. For a young woman, a secret wedding of her own is a call to guard her good name. A wedding everyone approves of brings respect from those around her. Her partner marrying someone else means her fears are needless: he will keep his word. A guest in mourning at the wedding points to sorrows in married life.
You see wedding clothes. Pleasant tasks and new friends await you. Soiled or messy wedding clothes mean you may drift apart from someone you admire.

You see your wedding ring. If the ring shines, worries and infidelity will pass you by. A lost or broken ring points to sadness and a chill in the relationship. A wedding ring on someone else's hand warns you not to take your promises lightly.

You dream of your wife. Your affairs are still unsettled, and there may be disagreements at home. A wife who is especially warm in the dream means profit from an important venture. For a wife, seeing her husband scold her points to criticism and confusion at home.

You run away in secret with your beloved to get married. An unfavourable dream: be careful with your feelings and actions. For the married, the dream says to guard your good name. For the single, it warns of disappointment in love. If your beloved runs off with someone else, doubt their faithfulness.

You are engaged to be married. The dream advises you not to wait for admiration but to prove yourself through deeds. Breaking off an engagement warns of a hasty, unwise step in an important matter. A business appointment in a dream means dull days and worries at work.

You cheat on your partner. The dream warns of gossip and of a deed you will have to answer for. Resisting temptation in a dream is always good. Giving in means trouble. For a woman, the dream advises keeping her temper in check so as not to lose warmth in the relationship.

Someone is courting you. You will keep waiting for a confession and a proposal, but your hopes may come to nothing. Courting someone yourself — ask whether you are ready for a real relationship. Don't mistake a passing thing for something serious.

You feel jealous. Ill-wishers and petty people are around you. Do not let them sow discord. Being jealous over a loved one: you will want to push a rival aside. A young woman jealous over her boyfriend: she may feel he prefers someone else. Being jealous over work matters: everyday hassles.

You love and feel loved. You will be content with your life, and good fortune in your affairs will free you from worry. Unreturned love means doubts about whether to change your life. For a couple, dreaming of each other's tenderness promises a happy home. Parents' love means integrity and steady progress. Love for animals means you value what you have.

You see roses in full, fragrant bloom. A joyful event is near, and the one you love will be faithful to you. For a young woman, picking roses means a proposal she will welcome. Withered roses: missing loved ones who are far away. Breathing in their scent: pure joy. A rosebush without flowers: growing prosperity.
You see a hot-air balloon. Hopes may fall through, and your affairs will slow down for a while. Rising in a balloon — an unlucky trip; better to postpone it.
You ride a bicycle uphill. Bright prospects ahead: your efforts are taking you upward. Riding a bicycle downhill means guard your health and good name and avoid needless risks.
You see a camera. Changes are coming that may put you in an awkward position. For a young woman, taking pictures means some unpleasantness ahead and a friend who may let her down badly.

You ride in a car. Your calm life will feel too small, and you will start making changes; act with care. The car breaks down on the way — the fun will be smaller than you expect. Dodging a car — keep away from a rival. Looking for a car — your efforts to win someone over will not pay off.
You drink cola. Don't get carried away by quick pleasures — they could cost you your health and a good chance. Look after your health and don't trade what matters for something fleeting.

You see a collision. Take your time on the road and at work, and small troubles and letdowns will pass you by. For a young woman seeing a collision — she won't be able to choose between two admirers, and it will stir up quarrels.

You read a newspaper. Be honest in your dealings: any slip may come to light and hurt your reputation. Printing a newspaper promises trips abroad and new friends. Trying but failing to read a newspaper foretells failure in a shaky venture.

You see a telephone. Strangers may confuse you and get in the way of your affairs. Don't give in to pressure. Talking on the phone means rivals, but you'll come out on top. Not hearing the other person well means gossip and a chill in a relationship.

You look at photographs. Beware: deception is close. Receiving a photo of your beloved — they are less loyal than they try to seem. Keeping other people’s photos while in a relationship — awkward secrets may come out. Having your own photo taken — carelessness will cause trouble for you and others.

You see a railroad. Keep a close eye on your affairs: someone wants your place. Walking along the rails — skillful handling of your affairs will bring much happiness. Walking on the ties — worry and hard work. An obstacle on the tracks — someone is playing dirty. For a young woman — a trip to visit friends and pleasant recognition.

You get into a railway car. Trips and quick changes one after another; a planned trip will go differently than you expect. Missing the train means your plans will be blocked. Getting off means success in an interesting venture. Seeing a tram means someone is trying to cause you trouble.
You see a refrigerator. Your selfishness may hurt someone who is honestly earning a living. Putting ice into it — you risk losing someone’s goodwill. Be more generous and attentive to people.
You see a rocket lift off. A sudden rise awaits you, along with luck in love and a faithful partner. A falling rocket: an unhappy union; do not rush to tie the knot.

You are riding in a taxi. Pleasant pursuits and a decent living. Riding in a taxi at night with others means you will have a secret to keep from friends. Riding with a woman warns of gossip. Driving a taxi yourself means hard work with little chance to advance.

You see a train racing at great speed. A quick rise in fortune and travel abroad await you. A broken-down train means hitches at work and postponed trips. A wrecked train means great distress and losses. Hearing a train approach means news from far away. A train whistle means a happy reunion with a long-absent friend or a profitable offer.

You are in an accident. The dream advises you to be extra careful on the road for the next few days and not to rush any trips. An accident with animals or livestock — you will get what you want through hard effort, but it will cost a friend dearly.

You are going up in an elevator. You will quickly rise to a good position and wealth. Going down in an elevator means setbacks that will knock you off balance. If the elevator leaves without you, you will narrowly avoid a disappointment. A stopped elevator warns of danger.
You watch a baseball game. You will be happy with little, and your good cheer will make you welcome in any company. For a young woman, playing baseball — lots of fun, though little real gain.

You are driving a car yourself. You may be unfairly accused of overspending, and work will force you to take on unpleasant tasks. If someone else is driving you, you will learn a lot from experienced people and always find a way through difficulties.

You dream of electricity. Sudden changes will happen around you, but they will bring neither gain nor joy. Getting an electric shock warns of danger. A live wire means enemies will disrupt your plans. If you travel instantly along a wire, you will overcome obstacles and turn others' plans to your advantage.

You see machines at work. You will take on a hard project that brings worry but turns out well in the end. Old machinery means enemies will get in the way of your progress. Getting caught in machinery tells you to guard your money and avoid risky deals.
